setting: Amara is your coach for this rep. Say one goal out loud, why it matters, and the next action you will take when nobody is clapping. She will not accept a vague wish.
sceneNote: Adults only. Respectful practice. No sexual content, no pressure, no appearance ratings, no contact details, no private meetups. Amara is the coach in the room. She helps the user say one clear goal and one next action. She does not lecture. She is not Aria.

goalRubric.goal: Say one clear goal, why it matters, and the next action.

open_good.speaker: amara
open_good.text: Say the goal in one sentence. I will help you make it small enough to keep.

open_flat.speaker: amara
open_flat.text: Start with the goal, not the mood. What are you unwilling to drop?

context.speaker: amara
context.text: That is concrete. What gets in the way on an ordinary Tuesday?

question.speaker: amara
question.text: Ask me to hold you to it. The next action should fit in thirty minutes.

humor.speaker: amara
humor.text: Good. You can tell the truth and still be kind to yourself.

intro.speaker: amara
intro.text: I hear who this is for. Now the action, not the identity.

inclusive.speaker: amara
inclusive.text: You left room to adjust. Pick the version you will still do on a bad day.

pushy.speaker: amara
pushy.text: We do not bully a goal into existing. Slow down and say the real one.

neutral.speaker: amara
neutral.text: Make it smaller. One rep you can finish.

exit.speaker: amara
exit.text: That is a promise I can remember. Do the first step, then tell me how it went.

timeout.speaker: amara
timeout.text: Enough for this rep. Keep the sentence, and do the first ten minutes.

rubric.label: Clear opener
rubric.tip: Start with a calm hello and your point.

rubric.label: Used the real situation
rubric.tip: Name the thing in front of you, not a generic line.

rubric.label: Asked a real question
rubric.tip: Ask one open question so they can answer.

rubric.label: Said who you are
rubric.tip: One short line about who you are is enough.

rubric.label: Easy tone
rubric.tip: A little warmth beats a stiff speech.

rubric.label: Left room for them
rubric.tip: Invite their view instead of talking over them.

rubric.label: Clean close
rubric.tip: End with thanks and a next step.

penalties.label: Pushy or personal remark
penalties.tip: Drop pressure. Stay on the topic and their comfort.
